summary: Petition under Section 17(3) and (4) of the Electricity Act, 2003, read with Article 15 of the Transmission Services Agreement, seeking approval for the creation of a security interest over all immovable and movable assets of the Petitioner, in favour of the Debenture Trustee. Adani Corporate House, CBD Shantigram, SG Highway, Khodiyar, Daskroi, Ahmedabad – 382421. **Petitioner VERSUS** 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation of a Security Interest in terms of the Debenture Trust Deed through the mortgage, hypothecation, charge, or assignment over rights, title, interest, claims, demands, benefits under, clearance, project documents, agreements, and approvals in favour of the Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (Respondent No. 2). Additionally, the Petitioner has requested for the approval of documents that create security as well as other documents pertaining to the debenture facility. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _“(a) Approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation/mortgage/ charge/pledge/assignment (as applicable), over all movable and other immovable assets (including over Petitioner’s benefits, rights, title and interest under the Transmission Service Agreement, the transmission license and other Transmission System documents) of the Petitioner, Lakadia Banaskantha Transco Ltd. by execution of relevant security creating documents in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Ltd. acting as Debenture Trustee on behalf and for the benefit of the Debenture Holders, as per the Debenture Trust Deed dated 01.07.2025 and the Debenture Trustee Appointment Agreement dated 17.06.2025; and_ _(b) Pass such other and further orders as may be deemed fit under the facts and circumstance of the present case."_ 8. As per the Debenture Trust Deed, the Petitioner has agreed to provide the following security to secure the Debenture holders: (i) all the right, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Issuer in, to and under all the Project Documents including the Transmission Service Agreement, duly acknowledged and consented to by the counterparties to the Project Documents, all as amended, varied or supplemented from time to time; (ii) all the rights, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands of the Issuer in, to and under all the Clearances pertaining to the Project; (iii) all the right, title, interest, benefits, claims and demands whatsoever of the Issuer in, to and under any letter of credit, guarantee, including contractor guarantees and liquidated damages, consent agreements, side letters and performance bond provided by any party to the Project Documents, both present and future; and 9. The Petitioner has submitted that, in terms of Article 15.2 of the Transmission Service Agreement, it is entitled to create an encumbrance over all or part of its receivables or transmission assets in favour of the Debenture Trustee, subject to obtaining prior approval from this Commission. 10. The Petitioner has further submitted that in view of the provisions of subsections (3) and (4) of Section 17 of the Act, the Petitioner, as a licensee, cannot create any security interest over its assets without prior approval of the Commission. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking approval for the creation of security by the Petitioner over the Petitioner’s Assets in favour of Respondent No. 2 acting as the Debenture Trustee for the benefit of the Debenture Holders and for their subsequent transferees, assignees, novatees thereof by way of hypothecation/ assignment/ mortgage, to the extent described in this Petition to secure the Petitioner’s obligations towards the Debenture Trustee under the Debenture Trust Deed dated 1.7.2025 and the Debenture Trustee Appointment Agreement dated 17.6.2025 aggregating to Rs. 578.50 crore only. 11. The matter was admitted on 25.5.2026, and notices were issued to the parties to file their respective replies. 12. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner reiterated the submissions made in the Petition and submitted that none of the Respondents have filed any reply to the instant Petition. After hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the matter was reserved for order. 15. The Petitioner has further submitted that, in terms of sub-sections (3) and (4) of Section 17 of the Act, as a transmission licensee, it cannot create any security interest over its assets in favour of the Debenture Trustee without the prior approval of this Commission. Accordingly, the present Petition has been filed seeking approval for creation of security over the Petitioner’s assets, in favour of Respondent No. 2, acting as Debenture Trustee for the benefit of the Debenture Holders and their respective transferees, assignees, and novatees, by way of hypothecation, assignment, or mortgage, as detailed in the Petition, to secure the Petitioner’s obligations under the Debenture Trust Deed dated 1.7.2025 . 16. The Petitioner has submitted that in terms of the Financing documents, the Petitioner is required to create a Security Interest on a first charge basis for the Debenture Trustee/ Debenture Holders. The Petitioner has submitted that under the Financing Agreements and on enforcement of a security interest, it shall be lawful for the lender and its assigns, transferees, and novates to enter into and take possession of the assets/ properties mortgaged/ hypothecated/ charges assigned for their benefits and substitute themselves or any one of them or its nominees for the Petitioner under _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ accordance with the terms of the Debenture Trust Deed. The Petitioner is directed to submit a signed copy of the Indenture of Mortgage and associated security documents immediately upon their execution.
title: Petition under Section 17(3) and (4) of the Electricity Act, 2003, read with Article 15 of the Transmission Services Agreement, seeking approval for the creation of a security interest over all immovable and movable assets of the Petitioner, in favour of the Debenture Trustee.
